name: Sentry Free Tier Error Tracking Reselling
rejection_reason: ToS §Restrictions(a) explicitly prohibits: 'provide access to (except for Users), distribute, sell or sublicense the Service to a third party'. §Restrictions(b) further prohibits: 'use the Service on behalf of, or to provide any product or service (except for Customer Applications) to, third parties'. These clauses are automatic vetos for any reselling/service-bureau/pooling model. While ToS mentions 'Purchase from Reseller', this refers to Sentry-authorized resellers only and does not permit independent free-tier pooling or wrapper services.

validation_attempts.result: Static HTML accessible via curl. Full legal text extracted. Restrictions section contains explicit anti-resell and anti-service-bureau clauses.
